scene: The open hatch reveals a bustling junction rooftop below the rainmaker masts.
picture: Side-scrolling flat rooftop junction. Far left, a yellow tow truck with neon hooks idles on a ramp. Left of centre, the player stands beside the flipped-open brass hatch. Centre, a turquoise motorbike with empty passenger sidecar sits parked. Right, a glowing gate leads to a red night funicular car. Up high, violet steam drifts.
shown: a yellow neon-rigged tow truck idling with engine humming on the far left
